# The Backpackers

> Kolkata-based travel company for mountain, hill and nature trips in India. Tagline: "Wander More, Worry Less."

The Backpackers organizes trips to Meghalaya, Arunachal Pradesh and Kashmir, with more mountain destinations planned. Travellers can join a group tour (planned departures with other travellers) or ask for a customized tour planned around their own dates, group size and travel style. Trip packages, prices and departure dates are shared on enquiry.
